title: fix(client): storage.upload sends application/octet-stream for a file of unknown type
body:
Fixes #28157

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

## What changes

- `packages/client/src/index.ts` (`storage.upload`): the presigned request now sends `mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'` instead of `file.type` bare. A typed file keeps its own type.
- `packages/client/src/storage-wire-dialect.test.ts`: two cases beside the existing storage wire tests. A `File` with `type: ''` produces a presigned request whose `mimeType` is `application/octet-stream`; control: a `File` typed `image/png` keeps `image/png`.
- `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx`: one sentence under the storage table saying the helper sends `application/octet-stream` for a file of unknown type.
- `.changeset/28157-upload-unknown-mime-type.md`: `@objectstack/client` patch.

The presigned door (`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`) is not touched: its `400 INVALID_REQUEST` on an empty `mimeType` is the published contract (`GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.mimeType` is `min(1)`).

Other SDK sites checked: `storage.upload` is the only place in `packages/client/src` that derives this door's `mimeType` from a `File`/`Blob` (`grep -n "\.type\b"` and `grep -rn mimeType` over `packages/client/src`, non-test, at `d70e94ae`: one hit, line 5371). `getPresignedUrl` and `initChunkedUpload` take a caller-built request; `uploadPart` and `resumeUpload` send no `mimeType`.

## Why

A browser `File` whose type the browser does not know carries `type === ''`. The SDK sent that empty string, the door refused it with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, and the user could not attach the file at all.

## Verification

Premise, measured on `d70e94ae` (unit level): with the fix reverted, the new case reads `"mimeType": ""` off the presigned request.

```
  + "mimeType": "",
restored:      Tests  12 passed (12)
```

Skills-docs: `grep -rn "storage\.upload\|mimeType" skills` has one hit, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:237` (`mimeTypes?` on a knowledge source, unrelated), so no skill text changes. `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx` gains the one sentence above. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:504` only shows the call and is unchanged.
